info.title: EarningsDesk API
info.description: Read-only earnings + options data for the EarningsDesk dashboard.

get.description:
Liveness + configuration report.

Deliberately reports *which* feature flags are off rather than just
ok/not-ok: the most likely failure here is a silently unloaded .env,
which looks identical to a healthy app until you request real data.

The most recent clean, priced trade of each kind, for the worked
examples on "How calls are tested".

AiSummary.title: AiSummary
AiSummary.description:
Structured so the UI can lay it out, rather than dumping a paragraph.

Describes what the numbers say. Never recommends a trade — see the
conventions in the engine's PLAN-BOT.md.

spot.title: Spot
spot.description: current price, not point-in-time at report_date

atm_open_interest.title: Atm Open Interest
atm_open_interest.description: contracts at the at-the-money strike, latest snapshot; low = wide spreads, hard to fill

DashboardNewsItem.title: DashboardNewsItem
DashboardNewsItem.description:
A `NewsItem` plus which tracked company it's about — the ticker page's
news list needs no such field (it's implicitly the page's own ticker),
but a feed spanning the whole universe has to say whose story this is.

EarningsHistoryRow.title: EarningsHistoryRow
EarningsHistoryRow.description: One past (or upcoming) earnings event, everything we know about it.

Fundamentals.title: Fundamentals
Fundamentals.description:
Company ratio grid — valuation, profitability, ownership, float.

Every field optional: yfinance omits a key entirely for a company that
genuinely has no such value (no dividend, no analyst coverage, a recent
IPO with no trailing EPS). That absence is information, and renders as
an em dash rather than a zero.

overpricing_bias.title: Overpricing Bias
overpricing_bias.description: positive = market consistently overestimates the move

HistoryStats.title: HistoryStats
HistoryStats.description:
Aggregates over the earnings history. Mirrors core.llm_context.TickerContext.

`hit_rate` is null below 4 scored events on purpose — a single correct call
reads as 100% accuracy and that number would get screenshotted. See
MIN_EVENTS_FOR_HIT_RATE.

HowWeScorePage.title: HowWeScorePage
HowWeScorePage.description: The most recent clean, priced trade of each kind, win or lose.

NewsItem.title: NewsItem
NewsItem.description:
One story. Only `title` is guaranteed — a feed item can arrive without a
resolvable link, and the UI renders those as plain text rather than as a
dead anchor.

richness.title: Richness
richness.description: implied / historical - 1; +0.30 means 30% richer than typical

atm_volume.title: Atm Volume
atm_volume.description: today's call+put volume at the ATM strike, vs. atm_open_interest

oi_by_strike.title: Oi By Strike
oi_by_strike.description: a window of strikes around the ATM, for a liquidity chart

skew_risk_reversal.title: Skew Risk Reversal
skew_risk_reversal.description: put IV minus call IV at ~25 delta. Positive = downside protection is the expensive side, the ordinary state for equities, so only an unusual level is informative. Describes option pricing, not a directional forecast.

iv_inverted.title: Iv Inverted
iv_inverted.description: front IV above back IV — the earnings premium

OptionsPanel.title: OptionsPanel
OptionsPanel.description: What the options market is pricing right now (as of the snapshot).

spot.title: Spot
spot.description: current price, not the price on report_date

PastEarningsRow.title: PastEarningsRow
PastEarningsRow.description:
One earnings event, any ticker — the cross-universe history feed.

Distinct from EarningsHistoryRow (per-ticker, in TickerPage): same shape
of fields, but this one carries `ticker` since it spans the whole
universe.

PastMove.title: PastMove
PastMove.description:
One past print's realized move — the observations behind
`hist_avg_move`.

Derived from daily closes rather than read off the scored history: only
~3% of history rows carry a realized move, since that field is written
by the scoring pipeline going forward and was never backfilled.

price_before.title: Price Before
price_before.description: close the session before the print

price_after.title: Price After
price_after.description: close the session that reacted to the print

PeerEarnings.title: PeerEarnings
PeerEarnings.description:
One related company's most recent completed print — how a similar-product
peer's last quarter actually played out, shown so a reader sizing up this
name's upcoming report can see the recent earnings environment for its
cohort.

Prices bracket the reacting session (see the engine's realized_move rules);
`move` is the signed fraction between them. `report_date` is that peer's own
print date, not this ticker's.

entry.title: Entry
entry.description: per share; negative = a credit collected

capital.title: Capital
capital.description: per share at risk; pnl_pct's denominator

ScoredExample.title: ScoredExample
ScoredExample.description: One real scored trade, for the "how calls are tested" page.

hist_avg_move.title: Hist Avg Move
hist_avg_move.description: typical move when the signal was taken; implied / this = priced multiple

spot.title: Spot
spot.description: current price, not the price at run_date

beat_implied.title: Beat Implied
beat_implied.description: null = event hasn't happened/been scored yet, not a miss

correct_direction.title: Correct Direction
correct_direction.description: null = event hasn't happened/been scored yet, not a miss

SiteIndex.title: SiteIndex
SiteIndex.description: Everything the frontend needs to render search and build static routes.

StrikeOpenInterest.title: StrikeOpenInterest
StrikeOpenInterest.description:
Open interest at one strike, split by side — one bar of the
open-interest-by-strike chart.

is_tracked.title: Is Tracked
is_tracked.description: False = outside the universe; no signal track record exists

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: BULLISH | BEARISH | NEUTRAL — the validated options-flow + sentiment lean for the *next* report, refined daily starting a few days out. Absent (not NEUTRAL) until that window opens; describes what the market's flow suggests, not a recommendation.

direction_as_of.title: Direction As Of
direction_as_of.description: the date this read was last refreshed, for an age/freshness label

news.title: News
news.description: null = fetch failed; [] = genuinely no news

past_moves.title: Past Moves
past_moves.description: Realized move per past print, oldest first. Empty until the nightly build populates it — a normal not-yet state, not an error.

peers.title: Peers
peers.description: Related companies (curated similar-product peers, else same-sector tracked names) with their most recent completed print's before/after prices. Empty when no peer has usable recent-earnings data yet.

fundamentals.description: null = the lookup failed or the symbol is unknown

analyst_ratings.title: Analyst Ratings
analyst_ratings.description: newest first; empty = no coverage or the lookup failed

excluded_far_expiry.title: Excluded Far Expiry
excluded_far_expiry.description: rich/cheap calls excluded: implied move measured off a far expiry

unverified.title: Unverified
unverified.description: rich/cheap calls with no expiry on file

direction_earned.title: Direction Earned
direction_earned.description: true once the directional lean clears the engine's gate (100+ scored reads at 55%+); until then the site hides it

TrackRecordPage.title: TrackRecordPage
TrackRecordPage.description:
Verdict accuracy and direction accuracy stay separate.

They are two independent axes — "the market overpriced this move" and "the
stock went up" are different claims. Collapsing them into one score would
misrepresent what the engine actually predicts.
